artifacts.name: test_platform_tabs_show_one_installer_and_follow_the_keyboard
artifacts.source_scenario: A visitor on macOS or Linux reaches Quick start and switches platforms with the keyboard or mouse.

expected.behavior: Three platform tabs exist with roving tabindex (0, -1, -1); macOS / Linux is selected first and only its shell command is visible; ArrowRight selects and focuses Windows and shows only the PowerShell command; End shows the uv and pip commands; Home returns to macOS / Linux; ArrowLeft from the first tab wraps to uv / pip; clicking a tab selects it.

artifacts.name: test_windows_visitors_see_the_powershell_installer_first
artifacts.source_scenario: A visitor on Windows opens the homepage.

expected.behavior: With a Windows user agent, the Windows tab is selected on load and the PowerShell command, not the shell command, is visible.

artifacts.name: test_copy_buttons_copy_the_exact_command_and_confirm
artifacts.source_scenario: A visitor clicks Copy next to each install command.

expected.behavior: Every copy row in every tab copies exactly its own command text to the clipboard, covering the shell, PowerShell, uv, and pip commands, and the status region reads Copied after each click and not before the first one.

artifacts.name: test_copied_is_announced_only_after_the_clipboard_write_resolves
artifacts.source_scenario: A visitor clicks Copy while the browser is still completing the clipboard write.

expected.behavior: While writeText is pending the status does not say Copied; once the write resolves the status says Copied.

artifacts.name: test_copy_failure_is_reported_instead_of_claiming_success
artifacts.source_scenario: A visitor's browser rejects clipboard access.

expected.behavior: When writeText rejects or navigator.clipboard is missing, the visible status says Couldn't copy and to select the command manually, and never says Copied.

artifacts.name: test_installer_scripts_are_linked_for_review_with_pinning_help
artifacts.source_scenario: A cautious visitor wants to read the installer and pin a release before piping it to a shell.

expected.behavior: The install section links install.sh and install.ps1 with same-origin relative hrefs, each link serves bytes identical to the repository script, the macOS / Linux panel shows `curl -LsSf https://maidrunner.dev/install.sh | sh -s -- --version <version>`, and the Windows panel shows a PowerShell form with `-Version <version>`, using parameters the scripts define.

artifacts.name: test_install_section_is_complete_without_javascript
artifacts.source_scenario: A visitor loads the homepage with JavaScript disabled.

expected.behavior: All four install commands are visible, and no tabs or Copy buttons are shown.
